research_rationale:
EO 10377 (July 25, 1952, Harry S. Truman; 17 FR 6891), on the composition of the Wage Stabilization Board, is read in full in the held Federal Register text. Section 1 revokes EO 10233 of April 21, 1951 and EO 10301 of November 2, 1951; section 2 amends Part IV of EO 10161 by revoking sections 403 to 410 and inserting a new section 403 (an eighteen-member Board of public, labor and business members under the Economic Stabilization Administrator); section 3 gives the order precedence over conflicting prior orders; section 4 makes it effective July 30, 1952. The order has no stated term. EO 10480 (August 14, 1953), held Federal Register text, lists it in section 607 among orders "superseded or revoked". That is the first end for every row.
